Invalid execution receipt marks request needs_review but leaves durable operation applying; stale invalid receipt can regress already-finalized request state
Coordinator run renewal extends coordinator expiry while INSERT OR IGNORE in grant service retains stale expiry and denies legitimate renewed use
Chunked request reads entire body before checking cap: 4096-byte limit consumed 102400 bytes before 413
Missed exact temporary start leaves approved role reservation with no cancel, revise or new-request recovery
AWS credential bridge accepts a mis-keyed administrator snapshot for another physical role without matching the approved manifest ARN/name
48-character accepted logical role produces 68-character AWS role name, exceeding the adapter's 64-character bound
